Name: Witchy Furniture and Decor by b0rszcz for Alternative Textures
Author: b0rszcz
Description:
Trying out something new for me, with this furniture and decor pack for Alternative Textures. Hope you'll like it! 


[b]Check out mod's media to see all the options! [/b]


[b]Requirements[/b]: 
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI - Stardew Modding API[/url] by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/1552317]Pathoschild[/url]
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url] by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/4112039]PeacefulEnd[/url]

[b]How to Install:
[/b]- Unzip the file
- Move the folder into your StardewValley/mods folder
- Use a Paint Bucket (purchasable at Carpenter's Shop)
- Done!﻿

You can see all available textures by using Texture Catalogue (also purchasable at Carpenter's Shop).


This mod is heavily inspired by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/178097142]EndyLau[/url]'s [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16615](AT)Hayao Miyazaki style furniture[/url]
